You Draft and submit to Sandra Okafor the branch-level portfolio stress response plan I offered in tick 2. The document covers three components: (1) a delinquency triage protocol for existing auto loan accounts — tiered by employment sector exposure, flagging accounts in auto manufacturing, dealership, and auto-adjacent services for enhanced monitoring and proactive outreach before they miss a payment; (2) a non-auto lending activation roadmap for the branch, targeting SBA-adjacent small business loans, home equity products, and personal lending — product lines I now have coursework grounding in after five months of the commercial lending module; (3) a 12-month volume replacement projection showing how the branch can offset 30% of auto loan origination decline through product diversification. Frame it as a branch evolution plan, not a crisis document. Send it with a direct note: I am ready to present this in person or on a call, and I am requesting authority to begin activating the non-auto product lines within my existing underwriting mandate..
